decisions.reason: The candidate already records the Coming Soon mode and the transition to enabling booking without redesign; no additional state change is required.
The template already uses the Seattle page as its basis and supports additions without redesign; Seattle's temporary booking status adds no necessary template change.
Temporarily disabling Seattle booking does not change the package catalog or pricing policy.
The master site remains non-booking and continues to delegate bookings to separate location sites.
Seattle's temporary booking availability does not change the requirement for each location to have a dedicated, consistently branded experience.
Public booking availability does not alter backend data isolation, and the same source already separately records the newly specified isolation dimensions.
The Seattle VIP signup and its button label remain required while booking is disabled.
Seattle's booking activation timing does not change the mobile-friendly design requirement.
The source does not remove Seattle from the selector or change routing to its separate location site; only booking on that site is temporarily disabled.
The temporary Seattle booking state does not change the SMASH ROOM brand identity or cross-location branding policy.
Booking activation timing does not modify the visual style, design references, navigation style, or design consistency.
The Seattle location page's temporary booking status does not change the master homepage sections or offerings presentation.
